messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Event to close session.
parts:
There is actually direct support in Shiny for this (though I can't seem to find documentation for it...):

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {
    # The session ended
  })
})

There is also a session$isClosed() method.
